headings: Sale of Oncology Business to Servier and Sale of Contingent Payments
paragraphs: We are a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to redefining the future of rare disease treatment. Fueled by connections, we build trusted partnerships with communities, collaborating to develop and deliver innovative medicines with the potential to transform lives. With a foundation in hematology, we combine biological expertise with real-world insights to advance a growing pipeline of rare disease medicines that reflect the priorities of the people we serve.

The lead product candidate in our portfolio, mitapivat, is an activator of both wild-type and mutant pyruvate kinase, or PK, enzymes for the potential treatment of hemolytic anemias. Mitapivat is approved in the United States by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, or FDA, under the brand name AQVESME™ for the treatment of anemia in adults with non-transfusion dependent and transfusion-dependent alpha- or beta-thalassemia and in Saudi Arabia under the brand name PYRUKYND® for the treatment of adult patients with non-transfusion-dependent and transfusion-dependent alpha- or beta-thalassemia. Mitapivat is also approved under the brand name PYRUKYND® in the United States by the FDA for the treatment of hemolytic anemia in adults with PK deficiency and in the European Union, or EU, and Great Britain for the treatment of PK deficiency in adults.

In December 2024, we announced that we submitted a marketing authorization application, or MAA, to the European Medicines Agency, or EMA, and a regulatory application to the United Arab Emirates health authorities for PYRUKYND® for the treatment of adult patients with non-transfusion dependent and transfusion-dependent alpha- or beta-thalassemia. In October 2025, we announced that the Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use, or the CHMP, of the EMA adopted a positive opinion for the new indication for PYRUKYND® in adults for the treatment of anemia associated with transfusion-dependent and non-transfusion-dependent alpha- or beta-thalassemia. The European Commission is reviewing the CHMP's opinion, with the final decision expected in early 2026.

We will have a pre-supplemental New Drug Application, or sNDA, meeting with the FDA in the first quarter of 2026 and intend to submit a U.S. marketing application for mitapivat in sickle cell disease, or SCD, following that engagement.

In addition, we are evaluating mitapivat for the treatment of pediatric patients with PK deficiency. We are also developing (i) tebapivat, a novel PK activator, for the potential treatment of lower-risk myelodysplastic syndromes, or LR MDS, and SCD; (ii) AG-181, our phenylalanine hydroxylase, or PAH, stabilizer for the potential treatment of phenylketonuria, or PKU; and (iii) AG-236, an siRNA in-licensed from Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc., or Alnylam, targeting the transmembrane serine protease 6, or TMPRSS6, gene for the potential treatment of polycythemia vera, or PV.

On July 28, 2023, we entered into a license agreement with Alnylam under which we acquired the rights to develop and commercialize Alnylam's novel preclinical siRNA targeting the TMPRSS6 gene, which we refer to as AG-236, as a potential disease-modifying treatment for patients with PV.

In accordance with the license agreement, we made an up-front payment to Alnylam and recognized in-process research and development of $17.5 million in the year ended December 31, 2023. We will also pay Alnylam for certain expenses associated with the development of AG-236, and these will be recorded in our consolidated statements of operations as incurred. Additionally, we are responsible to pay up to $130.0 million in potential development and regulatory milestones, in addition to sales milestones as well as tiered royalties on annual net sales, if any, of licensed products, which may be subject to specified reductions and offsets. In the year ended December 31, 2025, we achieved a regulatory milestone that triggered a $10.0 million payment to Alnylam, which was recorded in research and development expense within our consolidated statements of operations and classified as investing activities within our consolidated statements of cash flows. Because the acquired assets under the license agreement with Alnylam do not meet the definition of a business in accordance with Accounting Standards Codification, or ASC, 805, Business Combinations, we accounted for the agreement as an asset acquisition.

On March 31, 2021, we completed the sale of our oncology business to Servier Pharmaceuticals, LLC, or Servier. The transaction included the sale of our entire oncology business, including our clinical-stage product candidate vorasidenib, for a payment of approximately $1.8 billion in cash at the closing, subject to certain adjustments, and a payment of $200.0 million in cash, if, prior to January 1, 2027, vorasidenib is granted new drug application, or NDA, approval from the FDA with an approved label that permits vorasidenib's use as a single agent for the adjuvant treatment of patients with Grade 2 glioma that have an isocitrate dehydrogenase, or IDH, 1 or 2 mutation (and, to the extent required by such approval, the vorasidenib companion diagnostic test is granted an FDA premarket approval), or the Vorasidenib Milestone Payment, and a royalty of 15% of U.S. net sales of vorasidenib from the first commercial sale of vorasidenib through loss of exclusivity, or the Vorasidenib Royalty Rights. The Vorasidenib Milestone Payment and Vorasidenib Royalty Rights are referred to as contingent payments and recognized as income when realizable.

In August 2024, the FDA approved vorasidenib for adult and pediatric patients 12 years and older with Grade 2 astrocytoma or oligodendroglioma with a susceptible IDH1 or IDH2 mutation, following surgery including biopsy, sub-total resection, or gross total resection. In September 2024, we received the Vorasidenib Milestone Payment from Servier and recognized income of $200.0 million within the milestone payment from gain on sale of oncology business line item in our consolidated statements of operations for the year ended December 31, 2024. In May 2024, we entered into a purchase and sale agreement to sell the Vorasidenib Royalty Rights to Royalty Pharma Investments 2019 ICAV, or Royalty Pharma, for $905.0 million in cash, or the Upfront Payment. The sale was contingent upon FDA approval of vorasidenib and other customary closing conditions.

Upon consummation of the sale in August 2024, Royalty Pharma acquired 100% of the Vorasidenib Royalty Rights payments made by Servier on account of up to $1.0 billion in U.S. net sales for each calendar year. In addition, any such Vorasidenib Royalty Rights payments made by Servier on account of U.S. net sales in each calendar year in excess of $1.0 billion will be split, with Royalty Pharma having the rights to a 12% earn-out on those excess payments and Agios retaining the rights to a 3% earn-out on those excess payments, or the Retained Earn-Out Rights. As a result of the sale, we recognized income of $889.1 million ($905.0 million net of fees of $15.9 million) within the gain on sale of contingent payments line item in our consolidated statements of operations for the year ended December 31, 2024. Royalty income related to the Retained Earn-Out Rights, if any, will be recognized in the period when realizable.

We are building a sustainable, value-creating company, grounded in our expertise in cellular metabolism and classical hematology, focused on developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients.

We believe our proven PK activator franchise has the potential to become standard of care across multiple hemolytic anemias, supported by approved indications in PK deficiency and thalassemia. In addition, we see significant opportunity to unlock further value through a robust early- and mid-stage pipeline and we believe we have a clear path to profitability supported by our existing commercial portfolio. With a distinctive pipeline and a track record of disciplined execution, we believe Agios is well positioned to establish leadership in rare hematology and evolve into a sustainable rare disease company.

Our values cultivate an environment that promotes collaboration, contribution, engagement and high regard for others' points of view. This foundation helps our people push the boundaries of our science and create transformative medicines, which we believe will provide long-term benefits for all our stakeholders. Our connections – with each other and with the rare disease community we serve – fuel the development of new medicines. Our core values include:
•Aim High: We set the bar high for ourselves, and we keep working to raise it. At our core, we're guided by a deep respect for the science and a commitment always to act with the utmost integrity.

headings: Risks Related to the Discovery, Development, and Commercialization of our Products and Product Candidates
If we do not successfully commercialize PYRUKYND®, AQVESME™ and other products for which we receive approval, our prospects may be substantially harmed.
We may engage in in-licensing transactions or acquisitions that could disrupt our business, cause dilution to our stockholders or reduce our financial resources.
If we experience delays or difficulties in the enrollment of patients in clinical trials, our receipt of necessary regulatory approvals could be delayed or prevented.
Results of preclinical studies and early clinical trials may not be predictive of results of later-stage clinical trials.
We face substantial competition, which may result in others discovering, developing or commercializing products before or more successfully than we do.

Product liability lawsuits against us or any collaborators could cause us or our collaborators to incur substantial liabilities and could limit commercialization of any medicines that we or they may develop.
Risks Related to Our Financial Position
We face challenges as a less diversified company.
Raising additional capital may restrict our operations, require us to relinquish rights to our technologies or product candidates or cause dilution to our stockholders.
We have historically incurred operating losses. We expect to incur losses in the future and may never achieve or maintain profitability.
paragraphs: The following risk factors and other information included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K should be carefully considered. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only risks and uncertainties we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we presently deem less significant may also impair our business operations. Please see page 1 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for a discussion of some of the forward-looking statements that are qualified by these risk factors. If any of the following risks occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations and future growth prospects could be materially and adversely affected.

Our ability to generate meaningful revenue from PYRUKYND® and AQVESME™ will depend heavily on our successful development and commercialization of the product. We generated $54.0 million, $36.5 million and $26.8 million of net product revenues from sales of PYRUKYND® in the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively. We commercially launched AQVESME™ in the United States in late January 2026. In connection with our regulatory approvals in the EU, Great Britain and Saudi Arabia, we are currently providing access to PYRUKYND® through the Avanzanite Agreement and the NewBridge Agreement, as applicable, and on a for charge and free of charge basis for eligible patients in those jurisdictions and other jurisdictions through a global managed access program. Revenues associated with the NewBridge Agreement, the Avanzanite Agreement and our global managed access program are included in the rest of world product revenue line within Results of Operations. We continue to evaluate other options for the commercialization of PYRUKYND® outside of the United States, including through exploring potential partnership opportunities.
The development and commercialization of PYRUKYND® or AQVESME™ could be unsuccessful if:
•the medical community and third-party payors do not accept PYRUKYND® or AQVESME™ as safe, efficacious and cost-effective in the approved jurisdictions and indications;
•we fail to maintain the necessary financial resources and expertise to manufacture, market and sell PYRUKYND® or AQVESME™;

•we fail to develop, implement and maintain effective marketing, sales and distribution strategies and operations for the development and commercialization of PYRUKYND® or AQVESME™, including PYRUKYND® under the NewBridge Agreement and the Avanzanite Agreement;

Since inception, our operations have primarily focused on organizing and staffing our company, business planning, raising capital, assembling our core capabilities in cellular metabolism and classical hematology, identifying potential product candidates, undertaking preclinical studies, conducting clinical trials, establishing a commercial infrastructure, preparing for and executing on the commercial launches of PYRUKYND® and AQVESME™ and, prior to the sale of our oncology business to Servier on March 31, 2021, marketing TIBSOVO® and IDHIFA®. Through March 31, 2021, we financed our operations primarily through proceeds from the sale of our royalty rights, commercial sales of TIBSOVO®, funding received from our collaboration agreements, private placements of our preferred stock, our initial public offering of our common stock and concurrent private placement of common stock to an affiliate of Celgene, and our follow-on public offerings. Following the sale of our oncology business to Servier on March 31, 2021, we have financed and expect to continue to finance our operations primarily through cash on hand, potential royalty payments with respect to the Retained Earn-Out Rights, the actual and potential future sales of PYRUKYND®, the potential future sales of AQVESME™ if successfully launched by us and, potentially, collaborations, strategic alliances, licensing arrangements and other nondilutive strategic transactions. In addition, we may pursue opportunistic debt offerings, and equity or equity-linked offerings.

Additionally, since inception, we have historically incurred significant operating losses. Our net loss for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $412.8 million, our net income for the year ended December 31, 2024 was $673.7 million and our net loss for the year ended December 31, 2023 was $352.1 million. As of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $561.7 million. The net income we generated in the year ended December 31, 2024 was primarily due to the sale of the Vorasidenib Royalty Rights to Royalty Pharma and our receipt of the Vorasidenib Milestone Payment discussed above in Overview. We expect to continue to incur significant expenses and net losses until such time we are able to report profitable results. We may never achieve or maintain profitability, and our net losses may fluctuate significantly from year to year. We expect that we will continue to incur significant expenses as we continue to advance and expand our commercialization activities for PYRUKYND®; continue our commercialization activities for AQVESME™; continue to advance clinical development and regulatory activities for mitapivat, tebapivat, AG-181 and AG-236; expand and protect our intellectual property portfolio, including by in-licensing or acquiring assets for pipeline growth; and hire additional commercial and development personnel.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，致力於重新定義罕見疾病治療的未來。我們以連結為動力，與社區建立可信任的夥伴關係，合作開發與交付具潛力改變生命的創新藥物。我們以血液學為基礎，結合生物學專業與現實世界見解，推動一項日益成長的罕見疾病藥物研發管道，反映我們服務對象的優先事項。

我們產品組閤中的領先候選藥物，mitapivat，是一種活化野生型與變異型丙酮酸激酶，或PK，酵素的藥物，用於治療溶血性貧血的潛在治療。mitapivat已獲美國食品藥物管理局，或FDA，核准上市，品牌為AQVESME™，用於治療非輸血依賴型與輸血依賴型α-或β-地中海貧血成人患者，在沙烏地阿拉伯則以PYRUKYND®品牌核准，用於治療非輸血依賴型與輸血依賴型α-或β-地中海貧血成人患者。mitapivat也以PYRUKYND®品牌在美國由FDA核准，用於治療PK缺乏症成人患者的溶血性貧血，在歐盟，或EU，及英國則核准用於治療成人PK缺乏症。

2024年12月，我們宣佈已向歐洲藥物管理局，或EMA，提交PYRUKYND®的上市許可申請，或MAA，並向阿拉伯聯合大公國衛生主管機關提交相關法規申請，用於治療非輸血依賴型與輸血依賴型α-或β-地中海貧血成人患者。2025年10月，我們宣佈EMA的藥物產品委員會，或CHMP，對PYRUKYND®在成人患者治療與輸血依賴型及非輸血依賴型α-或β-地中海貧血相關貧血的新適應症採納正面意見。歐洲委員會正在審查CHMP的意見，預計2026年初做出最終決定。
我們預計在2026年第一季與FDA進行預補充新藥申請，或sNDA，會議，並計畫在該會議後提交mitapivat用於治療地中海貧血，或SCD，的美國上市申請。

此外，我們正在評估mitapivat用於治療PK缺乏症的兒童患者。我們也正在開發(i) tebapivat，一種新型PK活化劑，用於治療低風險骨髓增生異常綜合症，或LR MDS，及SCD；(ii) AG-181，我們的苯丙酮酸氫化酶，或PAH，穩定劑，用於治療苯丙酮尿症，或PKU；以及(iii) AG-236，一種從Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc.，或Alnylam，取得授權的siRNA，目標為跨膜絲氨酸蛋白酶6，或TMPRSS6，基因，用於治療紅血球增多症，或PV。
2023年7月28日，我們與Alnylam簽訂授權協議，取得開發與商業化Alnylam的新型預臨牀siRNA的權利，該siRNA針對TMPRSS6基因，我們稱為AG-236，作為治療PV患者的潛在疾病修正治療。

根據授權協議，我們已向Alnylam支付一筆 upfront 金額，並在2023年12月31日財務年度中確認進程中的研究與開發費用為17.5百萬美元。我們也將支付Alnylam與AG-236開發相關的某些費用，這些費用將在我們合併財務報表的營運費用中按實際發生計入。此外，我們需支付最高達130.0百萬美元的潛在開發與法規里程碑費用，以及銷售里程碑費用，以及在年度淨銷售額，如有，的分層版稅，這些可能受指定減免與抵銷影響。在2025年12月31日財務年度中，我們達成一項法規里程碑，觸發支付Alnylam 10.0百萬美元，該筆金額已計入我們合併財務報表的研發費用，並在合併現金流量表中歸類為投資活動。因為根據會計準則編碼，或ASC，805，企業合併，與Alnylam的授權協議取得的資產不屬於企業，我們將該協議視為資產取得。

2024年8月，美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）核准 vorasidenib 用於12歲以上，經手術（包括活檢、部分切除或完全切除）後，患有Grade 2星形細胞瘤或少突神經膠質瘤且具IDH1或IDH2易感性突變的成人及兒童患者。2024年9月，本公司自Servier收取Vorasidenib里程碑付款，並於2024年12月31日財務年度結算時，於合併營運損益表中，於「獲利來自癌症治療業務線項目」內確認收入200.0 百萬美元。2024年5月，本公司與Royalty Pharma Investments 2019 ICAV（或Royalty Pharma）簽訂買賣協議，以現金905.0 百萬美元出售Vorasidenib特許權使用費權利（Upfront Payment）。此交易依賴FDA核准vorasidenib及其他慣常關閉條件。

2024年8月交易完成後，Royalty Pharma取得Servier因美國淨銷售額達10億美元每年所支付的100% Vorasidenib特許權使用費權利。此外，若Servier因美國淨銷售額超過10億美元每年所支付的Vorasidenib特許權使用費，將由Royalty Pharma取得12%的買斷權利（earn-out），而Agios則保留3%的買斷權利（Retained Earn-Out Rights）。因該交易，本公司於2024年12月31日財務年度結算時，於合併營運損益表中，於「獲利來自或有付款項目」內確認收入889.1 百萬美元（淨額為905.0 百萬美元，扣除費用15.9 百萬美元）。若有任何Retained Earn-Out Rights相關的特許權使用費收入，將於可實現時確認。
本公司正建設一個可持續且能創造價值的公司，根植於我們在細胞代謝及傳統血液學領域的專業知識，專注於開發並提供創新藥物給患者。
我們相信我們已證實的PK活化劑系列產品有潛力成為多種溶血性貧血的標準療法，這由已核准的PK缺乏症及地中海貧血的適應症所支持。此外，我們看到透過強大的早期及中期產品管道，進一步釋放價值的顯著機會，並相信我們現有的商業產品組合已為我們建立明確的獲利路徑。憑藉獨特的產品管道及嚴謹執行的紀錄，我們相信Agios已具備領導罕見血液學領域並進化成為可持續的罕見疾病公司的優勢。
我們的價值觀培育出一個促進合作、貢獻、參與及尊重他人觀點的環境。這基礎有助於我們的員工突破科學的邊界，創造轉變性的藥物，我們相信這將為所有利害關係人帶來長期的效益。我們的連結——與彼此及我們服務的罕見疾病社羣——推動新藥的開發。我們的核心價值觀包括：
•目標高遠：我們為自己設下高標準，並持續努力提高標準。我們的核心是受到科學的深刻尊重，並始終以最高的誠信行事。

paragraphs: 您應閱讀以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果之分析，並與我們合併財務報表及相關附註，以及其他財務資訊一併參考。本報告中部分資訊，包括有關我們業務計畫與策略之資訊，包含風險與不確定性之預測性陳述。您應審閱本年度報告表10-K之「項目1A、風險因素」，以瞭解可能導致實際結果與預測性陳述中所述或暗示之結果有重大差異的重要因素。
我們是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，致力於重新定義罕見疾病治療的未來。我們透過連結建立與社區之信任夥伴關係，合作開發與交付具潛力改變生命的創新藥物。我們以血液學為基礎，結合生物學專業與實務洞察，推動日益成長的罕見疾病藥物研發管道，反映我們服務對象的優先事項。

我們產品組閤中的主要產品候選藥物，mitapivat，是一種活化野生型與變異型丙酮酸激酶，或PK，酶的藥物，用於治療溶血性貧血。mitapivat已獲得美國食品藥物管理局，或FDA，核准，品牌為AQVESME™，用於治療非輸血依賴型及輸血依賴型α-或β-地中海貧血成人患者，並在沙特阿拉伯以PYRUKYND®品牌核准，用於治療非輸血依賴型及輸血依賴型α-或β-地中海貧血成人患者。mitapivat也以PYRUKYND®品牌在美國由FDA核准，用於治療PK缺乏症成人患者的溶血性貧血，並在歐盟，或EU，及英國核准，用於治療成人PK缺乏症。

2024年12月，我們宣佈已向歐洲藥物管理局，或EMA，提交PYRUKYND®用於治療非輸血依賴型及輸血依賴型α-或β-地中海貧血成人患者的上市許可申請，或MAA，並向阿拉伯聯合大公國衛生當局提交相關監管申請。2025年10月，我們宣佈EMA的藥物產品委員會，或CHMP，對PYRUKYND®在成人患者中治療與輸血依賴型及非輸血依賴型α-或β-地中海貧血相關貧血的新適應症給予正面意見。歐洲委員會正在審查CHMP的意見，預計2026年初做出最終決定。
我們預計將於 2026 年第一季與美國食品藥物管理局舉辦一次預補充新藥申請，或 sNDA，會議，並計畫在該會議後提交美國上市許可申請，用於治療鐮狀細胞疾病，或 SCD，的 mitapivat。

此外，我們正在評估 mitapivat 用於治療患有 PK 缺陷的兒童患者。我們同時也在開發 (i) tebapivat，一種新型 PK 激活劑，用於潛在治療低風險骨髓增生異常綜合症，或 LR MDS，以及 SCD；(ii) AG-181，我們的苯丙酮酸氫化酶，或 PAH，穩定劑，用於潛在治療苯丙酮尿症，或 PKU；以及 (iii) AG-236，一種由 Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc.，或 Alnylam，授權進來的 siRNA，目標為跨膜絲氨酸蛋白酶 6，或 TMPRSS6，基因，用於潛在治療紅血球增多症，或 PV。
2023 年 7 月 28 日，我們與 Alnylam 籤訂授權協議，取得開發與商業化 Alnylam 新型臨牀前 siRNA 的權利，該 siRNA 目標為 TMPRSS6 基因，我們稱為 AG-236，作為潛在治療 PV 患者的疾病修正療法。

依許可契約條款，我們已支付 Alnylam 預付金，並於 2023 年 12 月 31 日會計年度內確認進程中的研究與開發費用 17.5 百萬美元。我們亦將支付 Alnylam 與 AG-236 開發相關之特定費用，這些費用將於我們合併營運費用中按實際發生計入。此外，我們需支付最高達 130.0 百萬美元之潛在開發與監管里程碑付款，以及銷售里程碑付款，以及針對已授權產品之年度淨銷售額（如有）之階梯式版稅，此等付款可能受特定減免與抵銷條款所影響。於 2025 年 12 月 31 日會計年度內，我們達成一項監管里程碑，因而觸發支付 Alnylam 10.0 百萬美元，此筆付款已計入我們合併營運費用中之研究與開發費用，並於我們合併現金流量表中歸類為投資活動。由於根據會計準則編碼集（ASC）805，企業合併之定義，許可契約中取得之資產不構成一項業務，因此我們將該契約視為資產取得處理。
於 2021 年 3 月 31 日，本公司完成將我們的腫瘤學業務出售給 Servier Pharmaceuticals, LLC，或 Servier。此交易包含出售我們全部的腫瘤學業務，包括我們臨牀階段的產品候選藥物 vorasidenib，交易對價為於交割時支付約 1.8 十億美元現金，視特定調整事項而定，並支付 200.0 百萬美元現金

若於 2027 年 1 月 1 日前，vorasidenib 獲得美國食品藥物管理局，或 FDA，批准新藥申請，或 NDA，並取得核准標籤允許 vorasidenib 作為單一藥物用於 Grade 2 腎上腺瘤患者之輔助治療，該患者具有 isocitrate dehydrogenase，或 IDH，1 或 2 突變（且視核准要求而定，vorasidenib 的伴診診斷測試亦獲得 FDA 市場前核准），或 Vorasidenib 里程碑付款，以及 15% 的美國 vorasidenib 淨銷售額 royalty，自 vorasidenib 首次商業銷售至失去專屬權，或 Vorasidenib royalty 權利。Vorasidenib 里程碑付款與 Vorasidenib royalty 權利被稱為條件性付款，並在可實現時確認為收入。

2024年8月，美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）核准Vorasidenib用於12歲以上、經手術（包括活檢、次全切除或全切除）後患有Grade 2星形細胞瘤或少突神經膠質瘤且具IDH1或IDH2易感性突變的成人及兒童患者。2024年9月，本公司自Servier收到Vorasidenib里程碑付款，並於2024年12月31日財務年度合併營運損益表中，就 oncology 事業線項目的銷售獲利，認列200.0 百萬美元收入。2024年5月，本公司與Royalty Pharma Investments 2019 ICAV（或稱Royalty Pharma）簽訂買賣協議，以現金905.0 百萬美元出售Vorasidenib特許權使用費權利（Upfront Payment）。該交易依賴FDA核准Vorasidenib及其他慣例關閉條件。

於2024年8月交易完成後，Royalty Pharma取得Vorasidenib特許權使用費權利之100%，該權利為Servier因每年歷年財曆年度美國淨銷售額達至10.0億美元時，所支付之特許權使用費。此外，若Servier因每年歷年財曆年度美國淨銷售額超過10.0億美元而支付之Vorasidenib特許權使用費，將進行分配，Royalty Pharma享有對該超額支付金額12%之買斷權，Agios則享有對該超額支付金額3%之買斷權，或稱為保留買斷權。因該交易，我們於2024年12月31日財務年度結算時，於合併損益表之「 contingent payments 賣出收益」項目中確認收入為889.1 百萬美元（淨額為905.0 百萬美元，扣除費用15.9 百萬美元）。若有任何與保留買斷權相關之特許權使用費收入，將於該收入可實現之期間確認。

自成立以來，我們的業務主要聚焦於組織與僱用公司員工、業務規劃、籌集資金、組建我們在細胞代謝與經典血液學的核心能力、識別潛在產品候選品、進行臨牀前研究、執行臨牀試驗、建立商業基礎設施、準備並執行 PYRUKYND® 和 AQVESME™ 的商業發佈，以及在 2021 年 3 月 31 日出售腫瘤學業務給 Servier 之前，行銷 TIBSOVO® 和 IDHIFA®。截至 2021 年 3 月 31 日，我們主要透過出售 royalty 權利所得、TIBSOVO® 的商業銷售、合作協議所得資金、優先股的私募發行、首次公開發行普通股及同時向 Celgene 關係企業發行普通股、以及後續公開發行來資助營運。在 2021 年 3 月 31 日出售腫瘤學業務給 Servier 之後，我們已透過現金、潛在 royalty 支付（關於 Retained Earn-Out 權利）、PYRUKYND® 的實際與潛在未來銷售、AQVESME™ 的潛在未來銷售（若我們成功發佈）以及潛在的合作、戰略聯盟、授權協議及其他非稀釋戰略交易來資助並預期持續資助營運。此外，我們可能尋求機會性的債務發行，以及股票或股票相關發行。

headings: 與本公司產品及產品候選藥物之發現、開發及商業化相關之風險
若本公司未能成功商業化 PYRUKYND®、AQVESME™ 及其他經本公司取得核准之產品，本公司之前景可能受到重大影響。
本公司可能進行進口授權交易或併購，此等交易可能幹擾本公司業務，導致股東持股稀釋或減少本公司之財務資源。
若本公司在臨牀試驗中遭遇患者招募延誤或困難，本公司取得必要監管核准之時程可能延後或無法取得。
動物實驗及早期臨牀試驗之結果可能無法預測後期臨牀試驗之結果。
本公司面臨重大競爭，可能導致他人在本公司之前或更成功地發現、開發或商業化產品。
針對本公司或任何合作夥伴之產品責任訴訟可能導致本公司或其合作夥伴承受重大負債，並可能限制本公司或其合作夥伴開發之藥物之商業化。
與本公司財務狀況相關之風險
本公司為一間較少多元化的公司，面臨挑戰。
籌措額外資金可能限制我們的營運，要求我們放棄對技術或產品候選方案的權利，或導致股東持股稀釋。
我們過去曾產生營運虧損。我們預期未來仍將產生虧損，且可能永遠無法達成或維持獲利。
paragraphs: 下列風險因素及其他資訊包含於本年度報告表 10-K 中，應謹慎考量。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非我們所面臨的唯一風險與不確定性。其他未被我們所知悉或目前認為較不重要的風險與不確定性，也可能影響我們的業務運作。請參閱本年度報告表 10-K 第 1 頁，以瞭解部分與這些風險因素有關的前瞻性陳述。

本公司能否從 PYRUKYND® 與 AQVESME™ 產生具意義的營業收入，將嚴重取決於本公司能否成功開發並商業化該產品。本公司於 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度、2024 年 12 月 31 日財務年度及 2023 年 12 月 31 日財務年度，分別從 PYRUKYND® 銷售中產生 54.0 百萬美元、36.5 百萬美元及 26.8 百萬美元的淨產品收入。本公司於 2026 年 1 月尾於美國正式商業化 AQVESME™。為配合本公司在歐盟、英國及沙烏地阿拉伯的監管核准，本公司目前透過 Avanzanite 協議及 NewBridge 協議（視情況而定），以收費及免收費方式為符合資格的患者在這些司法管轄區及其他司法管轄區提供 PYRUKYND® 的使用權，並透過全球管理存取計畫進行。與 NewBridge 協議、Avanzanite 協議及本公司全球管理存取計畫相關的收入，包含於 Results of Operations 中的 rest of world product revenue 項目。本公司持續評估其他在美國以外地區商業化 PYRUKYND® 的選項，包括探討潛在的合作夥伴機會。
PYRUKYND® 或 AQVESME™ 的開發與商業化可能失敗，如果：
• 醫療界及第三方付款機構不接受 PYRUKYND® 或 AQVESME™ 在核准的管轄區及適應症中為安全、有效且成本效益佳；
• 我們未能維持必要的財務資源與專業知識以製造、行銷及銷售 PYRUKYND® 或 AQVESME™；
• 我們未能開發、實施並維護有效的行銷、銷售與分銷策略與作業，以進行 PYRUKYND® 或 AQVESME™ 的開發與商業化，包括 PYRUKYND® 透過 NewBridge 協議及 Avanzanite 協議的使用；
